titleEn: Wrap a line of text around a sphere
descriptionZh: 让一行文字沿球面弯折并向两侧转去，同时保留原照片的光线与构图。
descriptionEn: Bend one line of lettering around a sphere and let it turn away at both sides while preserving the original photo.
inputHintZh: 输入：一张球体照片和一行文字。
outputHintZh: 输出：保留原构图的球面贴字图片。文字准确度因图像模型而异，生成后请检查。
inputHintEn: Input: a photo of a sphere and one line of text.
outputHintEn: Output: an edited image with the lettering wrapped around the sphere. Text accuracy varies by image model; check the result.
prompt: 使用我上传的球体照片作为底图。仅在球体正面添加一行文字“【替换成你的文字】”。文字必须沿球面形成清晰的浅弧线：中间位置略低，两端逐渐抬高并沿球体两侧卷走；中央字形清楚，靠近两侧的字形明显变窄、倾斜并随曲面转向，末端在球体轮廓处自然消失。保留球体原有高光、阴影和纹理，让墨色轻微受原表面明暗影响。保持球体形状、视角、背景、构图和光线不变。不要把文字做成浮雕或漂浮贴纸，不要添加其他符号，也不要改写文字。输出一张编辑后的图片。
promptEn: Use my uploaded sphere photo as the base image. Add only one line of text, “【replace with your text】”, to the front of the sphere. The text must form a clearly visible shallow arc across the sphere: the center sits slightly lower, and both ends rise gradually and wrap around the sphere’s sides. Keep the center letters clear; make letters near both sides distinctly narrower and tilted as they turn with the surface, with the ends naturally disappearing at the sphere’s silhouette. Preserve the sphere’s original highlights, shadows, and texture so the ink subtly responds to the existing light. Keep the sphere shape, camera angle, background, framing, and lighting unchanged. Do not make the letters embossed or floating, add other symbols, or rewrite the text. Output one edited image.
modelCapabilityNote: 本条为 AI 栅格图像编辑示例；不会输出可编辑矢量或分层源文件，也不保证每个模型都能准确生成指定文字。

descriptionZh: 让印字压过胸前明显的斜褶并随之局部变形，同时保留织纹、光影和衣服结构。
descriptionEn: Print a line across a visible diagonal crease, warping the letters locally while retaining knit grain, folds, and light.
inputHintZh: 输入：一张可使用、且印字区域有清晰褶皱的衣物照片，以及一行文字或标识。
outputHintZh: 输出：文字看起来印在布料上、随褶皱变化的编辑图片；文字准确度因模型而异，请检查。
inputHintEn: Input: a usable garment photo with a visible fold where the print should go, plus one line of text or a logo.
outputHintEn: Output: an edited image with print that follows the fabric folds. Text accuracy varies by model; check the result.
prompt: 以我上传的衣物照片作为底图。只在胸前清晰可见的斜褶上加入一行文字“【替换成你的文字】”，做成哑光丝网印花；不要把字放在平整区域。至少让一道明显布褶横穿多个字母。字形必须随褶皱局部弯折：织物凹陷处压缩笔画并略微挤窄字母，凸起折脊上轻微拉伸，经过斜褶时改变局部倾斜，让字的笔画本身看得出起伏变形。让棉布细密织纹透过墨色，原有高光和深色折影连续作用在字面上，印墨边缘在纤维纹理处略微软化、断续。完整保留衣服轮廓、领口、接缝、拍摄角度、取景、背景和光线。不要让文字像贴纸一样平铺或悬浮，不做刺绣、浮雕，不添加图案，也不要改写文字。输出一张编辑后的图片。
promptEn: Edit the uploaded shirt photo and preserve its exact shirt, mannequin, seams, crop, camera angle, background, and studio light. Add one line reading “【replace with your text】” in matte screen-print ink across a clearly visible diagonal chest fold; do not place it on a smooth area. Make at least one pronounced fabric crease cross through several letters. The letterforms themselves must visibly bend at the crease: compress strokes and narrow the letters where the cloth tucks inward, stretch them slightly over a raised ridge, and change their local slant as the surface turns. Let the cotton knit grain show through the ink, keep the original highlights and dark fold shadows continuous across the lettering, and soften or break the ink edges slightly where the fibers are visible. Preserve the garment, collar, seams, crop, camera angle, background, and lighting. Do not make the text a flat or floating sticker, embroidery, or embossing; add no graphics and do not rewrite the text. Output one edited image.
modelCapabilityNote: 本条为 AI 栅格图像编辑示例；不会输出可编辑图层或文字对象，也不保证其他模型能准确生成指定文字。

titleEn: Remove an object and its cast shadow
descriptionZh: 移除画面中的物体及其投影，并沿周围桌板纹理补绘被遮挡区域。
descriptionEn: Remove an object and its cast shadow, then reconstruct the hidden tabletop with matching wood grain and perspective.
inputHintZh: 输入：一张可编辑的物体照片，物体后方有可延续的桌面或背景纹理。
outputHintZh: 输出：移除物体和关联投影并补绘背景的栅格图片；生成式编辑可能重绘范围外像素，请检查明显偏差。
inputHintEn: Input: a photo of an object against a tabletop or background with texture that can continue behind it.
outputHintEn: Output: a raster edit with the object and related shadow removed and the background reconstructed. Generative edits may alter pixels outside the target; check for obvious changes.
prompt: Edit this photograph as a clean object-removal demonstration. Remove only the terracotta vase and its entire cast shadow on the tabletop. Reconstruct the previously hidden area as a natural continuation of the existing warm oak tabletop, matching the horizontal board direction, grain scale, knots, color, perspective, and light falloff from nearby wood. Preserve the cream textured plaster wall, table edge, framing, and overall warm lighting appearance. Avoid changing anything outside the vase-and-shadow removal area; inspect for and correct obvious unrelated changes. The finished image should contain no vase, no shadow residue, no blur patch, and no new objects or text. Photorealistic.
promptEn: Edit this photograph as a clean object-removal demonstration. Remove only the terracotta vase and its entire cast shadow on the tabletop. Reconstruct the previously hidden area as a natural continuation of the existing warm oak tabletop, matching the horizontal board direction, grain scale, knots, color, perspective, and light falloff from nearby wood. Preserve the cream textured plaster wall, table edge, framing, and overall warm lighting appearance. Avoid changing anything outside the vase-and-shadow removal area; inspect for and correct obvious unrelated changes. The finished image should contain no vase, no shadow residue, no blur patch, and no new objects or text. Photorealistic.
modelCapabilityNote: 本条为 AI 栅格图片编辑示例；不会保留可编辑图层或蒙版，生成式补绘可能修改目标区域之外的像素，需检查明显偏差。
